subject: Startups
title: Notion's Community Playbook
description: A quick, practical guide to Notion's Community Playbook.

hook.text: Notion didn't build a marketing team. Its community of power users made templates, tutorials, and courses for free.

buildup.text: Notion's flexible design made it infinitely customizable. Users loved sharing their setups on social media.

discovery.text: Template creators became influencers. YouTube channels about Notion productivity attracted millions of views.

twist.text: Notion benefited from free content it didn't create. The community did the marketing work unpaid and gladly.

climax.text: Notion reached 30 million users largely through community content. It spent far less on ads than competitors.

punchline.text: Build for power users and they'll recruit everyone else.

quiz.question: What drove most of Notion's early growth?
